name: guard-rules
description: Blocks AI attribution in commits and PRs, direct commits to protected branches, commits under the wrong git identity, and mutating kubectl, helm and terraform calls on protected or unclassified environments.

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated branch names (a * wildcard is allowed) that commits, merges and pushes must not touch directly.

identityRules.title: Identity rules
identityRules.description: JSON array of {"prefix": "~/path/", "email": "you@example.com"}. A repository under a prefix must commit as that email; a repository under no prefix is blocked. Empty turns the rule off.

protectedContexts.title: Protected environments
protectedContexts.description: Comma-separated kubectl/helm context and terraform workspace names (case-insensitive, a * wildcard is allowed) where changing commands are blocked.

relaxedContexts.title: Relaxed environments
relaxedContexts.description: Comma-separated names (case-insensitive, a * wildcard is allowed) where changing commands are allowed. A name in neither list is blocked until you classify it with /guard-context.

modeIdentity.title: Identity rule mode
modeIdentity.description: off, dry (report only) or on. Does nothing until identity rules are set.

modeContext.title: Context rule mode
modeContext.description: off, dry (report only) or on. Covers changing kubectl, helm, terraform and tofu calls.
